scope: 19 recorded calls across two accounts; latest client build has two short calls; pooled counts are not current-policy quality rates

opening_definitions.event_order: timestamp then pseudonymized event identifier; this is record order, not guaranteed audible turn order
opening_definitions.first_ai_message: first recorded assistant event in each call, including calls where a user event precedes it
opening_definitions.ai_prefix_block: all consecutive assistant events before first recorded user event; entire call if no user event exists
opening_definitions.first_response_ai_block: consecutive assistant events immediately after first recorded user event, until next user event
opening_definitions.greeting_detection: case-insensitive greeting word at beginning: common greeting variants plus morning salutation
opening_definitions.normalized_duplicate: NFKC + lowercase + ASCII alphanumeric token normalization; punctuation and spacing removed
opening_definitions.adjacent_pair: successive calls within the same account and companion, even if other companions were called between them

manual_opening_families.daily_detail_invitation: asks about recent or current everyday activities, feelings or small details
manual_opening_families.conversation_or_help_menu: asks learner to choose what to discuss, practice or receive help with
manual_opening_families.grounded_memory_callback: specific callback supported by supplied historical user evidence
manual_opening_families.response_to_initial_user: responds after user appears first in recorded event order

opening_definitions.semantic_counts: manual descriptive coding, not measured similarity or a quality score
opening_definitions.repeated_greeting_warning: responding to a user greeting is ordinary reciprocity; first-three greeting counts must not be read as duplicate playback defects

opening_limitations: Only two accounts and 19 calls; early short calls can include exploratory QA.
Only two brief calls are from the latest client build; do not generalize pooled rates to current policy.
Assistant messages and same-speaker blocks are not necessarily audible turns; no original audio or response lifecycle receipts were supplied.
No definite current-daypart mismatch was found; this does not verify all clock behavior.
Historical callback absence is not failure when history is irrelevant or sensitive.
The previous-client-build cohort has three longer calls and one brief memory-check call; it is not four long calls.

quality_source_integrity.candidate_interpretation: Single qualitative review candidates, not an established error rate or ASR ground truth.
quality_source_integrity.count_scope: 51 checked item groups; not the count of unique evidence IDs or all possible contextual citation fields.

data_handling: Aggregate only. No raw transcripts, real account/session/event identifiers or credentials.

conversation_style_descriptive.definition: Case insensitive word-bounded exact phrase if you want in recorded assistant text; an event counts once.
conversation_style_descriptive.interpretation: Descriptive phrase presence, not an error rate. Appropriate offers and responses to user help requests are included.
conversation_style_descriptive.latest_policy_limit: Two brief calls cannot establish long conversation behavior or user-perceived friendliness.
